body:
For v5.0.be section V8.3 contains now 2 requirements, section title is "V8.3 Sensitive Private Data" and requirements are:

* v5.0.be-8.3.8 Verify that sensitive personal information is subject to data retention classification, such that old or out of date data is deleted automatically, on a schedule, or as the situation requires.
* v5.0.be-8.3.9 Verify that sensitive information is removed from the metadata of user-submitted files unless storage is consented to by the user.

There is mismatch between section title, section text and requirements in it. As the content from the section got cleaned up, I think it makes sense to just add those 2 requirements into "V8.1 General Data Protection" section and remove the section.
